reference_sql:
WITH period_lines AS (
  -- one row per order line of an order placed in April 2025, with its UTC order day
  SELECT l.order_line_id, l.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
), priced AS (
  -- one row per order line: the price version in force on its order day (valid_to included, missing for the current price)
  SELECT w.order_line_id, ph.list_price_eur
  FROM period_lines w
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = w.product_id
    AND w.order_day >= ph.valid_from
    AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR w.order_day <= ph.valid_to)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM period_lines) AS lines_before,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM priced) AS rows_after,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM priced) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM period_lines) AS added_rows

  FROM order_lines l

  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'

  SELECT w.order_line_id, ph.list_price_eur
  FROM period_lines w

)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM period_lines) AS lines_before,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM priced) AS rows_after,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM priced) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM period_lines) AS added_rows

solver.query:
WITH ls AS (
  SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
), j AS (
  SELECT ls.order_line_id
  FROM ls LEFT JOIN price_history ph
    ON ph.product_id = ls.product_id AND ls.order_day >= ph.valid_from
    AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR ls.order_day <= ph.valid_to)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ls) AS lines_before, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM j) AS rows_after,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM j) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ls) AS added_rows
